description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to property description within the Orleans code generation project. It includes the 'PropertyDescription' class implementing 'IPropertyDescription', handling property metadata, type syntax conversion, and various property attributes.

classes.name: PropertyDescription
classes.description: Represents a descriptive model of a property in the Orleans code generator, including metadata, type syntax, and attributes like serializability and copyability.

methods.name: PropertyDescription
methods.description: Constructor initializes property metadata including field ID, primary constructor parameter flag, and property symbol. Sets up the type syntax based on the property type.

methods.name: GetTypeSyntax
methods.description: Converts a given ITypeSymbol to its corresponding TypeSyntax representation.
